description: Roslyn analyzers enforcing opinionated .NET conventions at compile time. 82 rules with code fixes covering design (sealed-by-default, async void, sync-over-async, ConfigureAwait, in-modifier safety, primary constructor fields, FileSystemInfo equality, TimeProvider, IHttpClientFactory, TimeSpan for durations, mutable collection exposure, DI registration, Task.Run async lambda, excessive inheritance, enum switch, List<T> as IReadOnlyList<T>, Dictionary<K,V> as IReadOnlyDictionary<K,V>, unused interface params, static readonly arrays as ImmutableArray, stale ReferenceAssemblies, readonly struct init, ByteSize for data-size values, ByteSize unwrap via cast), reliability (DateTime.Parse roundtrip, GeneratedRegex timeout/backtracking, hardcoded /tmp paths, Task.FromResult sync I/O, Task.WhenAll unbounded/cancellation, JsonDocument lifetime, concurrency limits, catch filter OCE, options bind init, HttpClient missing OCE catch, FileInfo.Exists TOCTOU, unprotected finally cleanup, disk write-then-read round-trip, pool capacity guard, QuerySelectorAll materialization, TextContent length guard, GetAttribute element type, CompositeDetection specificity), performance (MinBy/MaxBy, HttpCompletionOption, string interpolation, ToArray in foreach, FrozenSet allocation, multi-string OR-chain, static readonly frozen collections, loop complexity, SHA256.HashData, StringBuilderPool), security (FIPS-approved hash algorithms, insecure Random in crypto context), style (string.Empty, Encoding.UTF8, XML doc comments, temp path conventions, null-forgiving operator, suppression audit, pragma balance, IDE1006 naming rule fix), and testing (temp directory cleanup, stale ReferenceAssemblies, Trait category).
